boundaries: MCCS is creator-facing appearance/presentation tooling and does not become canonical Character, NPC, Creature, Species, Form, Inventory, Asset or relationship authority
MCCS consumes CAPP/PPIA renderer-neutral appearance authority rather than minting a second appearance truth model
PAPT remains the current pixel-production pipeline and art-language authority; MCCS is the entity-centric creator experience over those production capabilities
PCA supplies character asset, rig, garment, motion, style-generation and production primitives without becoming canonical entity authority
all imported/generated media resources and derivatives preserve ARI identity/provenance/rights rules
visual sliders, meshes, textures, poses and generated variants never silently create canonical anatomy, mechanics, equipment ownership or relationship state
MCCS is topology-first rather than humanoid-first and must expose unsupported/unresolved anatomy instead of forcing humanoid mapping
generic DCC/sculpt/rig/image capabilities should use lawful mature libraries/tools where practical rather than being rebuilt as general-purpose applications
P3D remains deferred and separate; MCCS-20 preserves a handoff seam without activating physical/3D miniature implementation
MNCS is the strict planned successor after MCCS-21 and may consume MCCS presentation outputs without making MCCS an NPC/Creature identity, persona, mechanics, ecology, behavior or relationship owner
proprietary benchmark products are clean-room planning provenance only; protected code/assets/character bases/styles/UI expression are not copied
no paid/cloud character provider is required for blocking workflows
no implementation authority until separately governed start
